title: OpenSearch OCSF Hunt
description: Executes OpenCTI hunts on security events normalized to the Open Cybersecurity Schema Framework (OCSF) and stored in OpenSearch, including Amazon OpenSearch Service. OpenCTI dispatches one hunt run per hunt and time window; the connector translates the canonical Sigma rule of the hunt into PPL or a Lucene query string with pySigma and its OCSF pipeline, or runs the native PPL or Lucene query written for OpenSearch, executes it over the run window within the run timeout and result limits, and reports the run to OpenCTI. When the hunt matches, the techniques and indicators of the hunt are sighted on the OpenSearch Security Platform and the IOC observables found in the results are sent as observed-data. Raw events never leave OpenSearch: OpenCTI only receives counts and a hashed, truncated evidence sample. Before you start: an internal user mapped to a role with cluster:admin/opensearch/ppl, read and indices:admin/mappings/get on the hunted indices. The least-privilege permissions, the console steps and a copy-ready configuration are at https://docs.opencti.io/latest/usage/hunt-connectors/#opensearch-ocsf, and Test connection on the connector page in OpenCTI checks them.
short_description: Runs OpenCTI hunts (Sigma translated to PPL or Lucene through OCSF, or native queries) on OpenSearch and reports hits, observed IOCs and redacted evidence.
